title: Monthly snow cover by elevation band, 2001 to 2025 (snow_cover_by_band 1.0.0)
description:
Precomputed result of recipe snow_cover_by_band 1.0.0 for Ait Bouguemez valley catchment: the monthly snow-covered share of each elevation band from 2001-01 to 2025-12, from 8985 daily Terra MOD10A1 v6.1 products (500 m), at NDSI thresholds 0.2 and 0.4, with the clear share of each band and month. Band sets: fixed_500m (below 2000 m, 2000 to 2500 m, 2500 to 3000 m, 3000 to 3500 m, 3500 m and above), terrain_strata (below 2317 m, 2317 to 2815 m, 2815 m and above). Observation; 2 of 300 catchment months fall below the clear share minimum of 0.3 or have no product.

MOD10A1 sees snow only on clear days. Cloudy days are left out, not filled, so a month's fraction describes its clear days; the clear share is shown with it. Against 448 Sentinel-2 scenes of the Atlas, Terra MODIS snow cover (version 6) was underestimated by 6.13% on average with the global NDSI threshold of 0.4 and overestimated by 0.34% with the Atlas threshold of 0.2 (Bousbaa et al. 2024). Both thresholds are shown. Against five Atlas stations, MOD10A1 (version 5) agreed with snow observations 89% of the time (2000 to 2013, other Atlas catchments; Marchane et al. 2015). There is no station comparison for this valley. Each 500 m pixel is called snow-covered or not as a whole; patchy snow, thin snow and snow on shaded slopes can be missed. Snow cover is not snow depth or water: it says nothing about how much water the snow holds. Terra's overpass has drifted earlier since 2020, from 10:30 to about 9:06 mean local time by December 2025 (NASA), so later years are seen with a lower sun and longer shadows, which may change snow detection on steep slopes.

providers.processing:lineage: Anonymous SAS-signed range reads of MOD10A1 v6.1 NDSI_Snow_Cover windows over the frozen geometry from Planetary Computer (9280 Terra days); Copernicus DEM GLO-30 elevation on the 10 m analysis grid; band shares weighted by 10 m analysis cells (science/pipeline/snow-bundle.py).

snow_cover_by_band.title: Summary: monthly snow cover fraction and clear share per band of the primary band set, both thresholds (the result read_recipe_result returns)

snow_cover_tables.title: Full tables: every band of every band set and month, product days, clear share, both thresholds

siterra:dataset.access_route: https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/api/stac/v1 collection modis-10A1-061, asset NDSI_Snow_Cover, anonymous SAS-signed COG range reads
siterra:dataset.resolution_note: Native 500 m MODIS sinusoidal grid (463.31 m cells), daily

siterra:geo_selection.area_method: Count of 10 m analysis pixels whose centres fall inside the frozen polygon, EPSG:32629

operation_order: v(p, d) = NDSI_Snow_Cover of Terra MOD10A1 v6.1 500 m pixel p on day d; clear when 0 <= v <= 100 (0 is snow-free land); cloud when v = 250; every other value (200 missing, 201 no decision, 211 night, 237 inland water, 239 ocean, 254 detector saturated, 255 fill) is not observed
snow_t(p, d) = 1 when p is clear on d and v >= 100 t, for the NDSI thresholds t = 0.2 (optimised for the Atlas, Bousbaa et al. 2024) and t = 0.4 (the global reference), computed side by side

w_b(p) = number of 10 m analysis cells of elevation band b whose centre falls in pixel p; elevation from the place's DEM, resampled to the analysis grid as for the terrain strata; band sets from the place configuration
clear_share(b, m) = sum over the days d of month m that have a product and over pixels p of w_b(p) clear(p, d) / sum over the same days and pixels of w_b(p)
snow_cover_fraction_t(b, m) = sum over d and p of w_b(p) snow_t(p, d) / sum over d and p of w_b(p) clear(p, d); reported only when clear_share(b, m) >= 0.3, otherwise insufficient_clear
product_days(m) = number of days of month m with a Terra MOD10A1 product over the place
The catchment as a whole is reported alongside the bands

siterra:checks.name: recompute_sample_period
siterra:checks.detail: Month 2025-01 rerun independently for the fixed_500m bands: 31 daily windows read again from Planetary Computer with a fresh token, 31 identical to the stored ones; each day resampled to the 10 m analysis grid by nearest neighbour and counted over each band's cells; largest difference from the stored clear share and NDSI 0.2 fraction 0.000043 over 5 bands (5 with a fraction), tolerance 0.0001 plus rounding.

siterra:checks.name: nodata_not_zero
siterra:checks.detail: NDSI_Snow_Cover 0 is snow-free land and counts as clear; flag values (200 missing, 201 no decision, 211 night, 237 inland water, 239 ocean, 250 cloud, 254 detector saturated, 255 fill) are not observed and never count as 0.

siterra:checks.name: units_and_scale
siterra:checks.detail: Every stored window is uint8 with nodata 255; values 0 to 100 are NDSI times 100, so threshold t is applied as a value of at least 100 t. Fractions are shares of 10 m analysis-cell-weighted pixel-days, 0 to 1.

siterra:checks.name: qa_join_coverage
siterra:checks.detail: All 9280 daily windows share one 90 x 68 pixel grid; 8985 of 9131 calendar days from 2001-01 to 2025-12 have a Terra product on Planetary Computer. 146 days absent from Planetary Computer (listed in the tables); on 2026-10-28 NASA CMR listed 73 of them (held by the NASA archive, which needs an Earthdata login, not used); 73 are missing there too. Catchment months below the clear share minimum or without a product: 2 of 300.

siterra:checks.name: period_alignment
siterra:checks.detail: A daily product belongs to the calendar month of its acquisition date (AYYYYDDD in the item ID).

siterra:checks.name: attribution_present
siterra:checks.detail: The NSIDC-required MOD10A1 v6.1 citation with subset and access date and the Copernicus DEM notices are in siterra:attribution
